provenance.giver: lang/ru — patronymic formation from the father's given name: masculine -ович/-евич/-ич, feminine -овна/-евна/-ична/-инична; transliterated forms as they appear in English translations (Maude, Garnett)
provenance.note: A patronymic is worn by every child of one father and individuates nobody by itself (the T5 lesson: Katerina Ivanovna / Alyona Ivanovna are two heads). It is never the head of a name. The suffix match applies to a name token of at least minLength letters so that English family names in -ich (Aldrich) are not read as patronymics; that floor is this prior's own declared parameter.
